item.title: Live Bait Vs Artificial: Pros & Cons When Ice Fishing
item.description: When it comes to ice fishing, bait generally falls into two main categories: live bait and artificial bait. The most common live options are wax worms, some fishermen call these “waxies,”and live minnows. Artificial choices usually include soft plastic wax worms, small bug-shaped plastics, or hard baits designed to mimic one- to two-inch minnows.
